title: Guardrails VML renders blank (visual layers missing)

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Observed guardrails VML renders audio-only with blank frames. Generated script.json has scenes but 0 layers/components. VML and .babulus.ts currently only voiceover + transitions. Need to locate prior YAML/visual definitions or port visuals into VML.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Found prior YAML in git history: videos/content/guardrails.babulus.yml (deleted in commit a28331a). YAML is narration-only (no visuals/layers/components). Visuals live in TSX: videos/src/videos/guardrails/GuardrailsVideo.tsx.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Starting conversion: will port visuals from GuardrailsVideo.tsx into guardrails.vml components/layers.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Resolved: VML renders include visuals after custom bundle uses Babulus registry/hooks. Rendered MP4 with slide-left transitions.
